players.product: MTT S5000/S4000 full-function datacenter GPU accelerator cards, MTT SGX5000 AI servers and KUAE 10,000-card AI training clusters

quarterly_data.quarter: Moore Threads half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (unaudited): operating revenue RMB 1,736,309,066.25, up 147.42% YoY from RMB 701,761,937.72; overall gross margin 56.95%; net loss attributable to shareholders RMB -11,563,095.44 vs RMB -270,942,340.80 a year earlier (loss narrowed 95.73%). The company attributes growth to strong demand for full-function GPUs, accelerating commercialization of its KUAE clusters built on MTT S5000, customer recognition of product performance and stable supply.

quarterly_data.quarter: Moore Threads half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue by product: cloud products (AI accelerator cards, AI servers, clusters) RMB 1,692,662,049.69; edge and terminal products RMB 40,521,566.25; other RMB 3,125,450.31. All revenue domestic; direct sales RMB 1,172,389,466.71, distribution RMB 563,919,599.54.

quarterly_data.quarter: Moore Threads half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration: 51.92% of accounts receivable came from the largest customer and 99.27% from the top five customers at June 30, 2026; the company flags that customer concentration has been high for the past three years. Customer types include major research platforms, internet companies, telecom operators, cloud service providers and AI firms.
quarterly_data.figure: Largest customer 51.92% of receivables; top five 99.27%

quarterly_data.quarter: Moore Threads half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: MTT S5000 (PH100 chip, fourth-generation 'Pinghu' architecture, FP8 to FP64) is the flagship training-inference GPU card; the company says single-card performance is in the industry's first tier and its KUAE 10,000-card cluster reaches model FLOPs utilization of 60% on dense models and 40% on MoE models, 95% training linear scaling and over 90% effective training time. The company says it is one of few GPU suppliers with commercial thousand- and 10,000-card single-network training clusters; a partner trained a MoE-236B base model from scratch on an MTT S5000 cluster, and BAAI's RoboBrain2.5 was trained on it.
quarterly_data.figure: MFU 60% dense / 40% MoE; 95% linear scaling; >90% effective training time

quarterly_data.quarter: Moore Threads half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Roadmap: the fifth-generation 'Huagang' architecture (released December 2025) supports clusters of 100,000+ cards and FP4 to FP64, with compute density up 50% and energy efficiency up 10x. The 'Huashan' AI chip and 'Lushan' graphics chip on Huagang are in development (H1 2026 R&D spend on Huashan RMB 27,583.73 ten-thousand); the company also announced the MTT C256 supernode architecture plan. H1 2026 R&D expense RMB 769,148,107.78 (+38.16%), 44.30% of revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: Huagang: compute density +50%, efficiency 10x; R&D RMB 769,148,107.78 (+38.16%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Moore Threads half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supply: inventory RMB 3,549,702,950.34 at June 30, 2026 (+166.48% vs end-2025), which the company says it actively built up to meet demand growth and secure supply-chain stability; prepayments RMB 1,343,561,673.04, 96.89% with the top five suppliers; inventory impairment loss RMB -39,047,666.14. Moore Threads has been on the US 'Entity List' since October 2023, restricting purchases of US-made materials and US-technology IP and tools; it is building a diversified supply chain with domestic and non-restricted suppliers. Cost of sales rose partly on semiconductor raw-material price increases.

quarterly_data.quarter: Moore Threads half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Cloud PC: the MTT S3000 supports 32 concurrent streams per card, with CPU load cut 75% and rendering performance up 10x via hardware-software co-design; the company has achieved commercial deployments with China Mobile and other leading operators in multiple provinces and cities. Ecosystem: Day-0 adaptation of DeepSeek-V4, MiniMax M3, GLM-5.2, Kimi K3 and MiniMax H3; developer count has passed 800,000 (80 wan).
quarterly_data.figure: MTT S3000: 32 concurrent streams per card
